tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Pricing for WCAG accessibility scans. Prices in USD, rate and daily limits, and links to the terms and privacy notice. Automated checks find roughly 57% of WCAG issues. Free.

tools.name: check_contrast
tools.description: Color contrast check (WCAG 2.2 AA/AAA) for up to 50 caller-supplied color pairs. No page is fetched. Each pair reports the contrast ratio, AA and AAA for normal and large text, the 3:1 non-text result, and a nearer foreground of the same hue when AA is not met. Price 0.01 USD in USDC on Base, settle

tools.name: check_links_meta
tools.description: Broken links and meta tag check for one public page. Reports title, meta description and its length, html lang, viewport, canonical, h1 count, og:title, and og:description, then checks up to 50 links on that page. authorized is true. No further pages are crawled. Price 0.05 USD in USDC on Base, sett

tools.name: scan_page
tools.description: WCAG 2.2 accessibility audit of one public web page. Returns rule ids, impact, WCAG tags, and up to three selectors. Default standard wcag22aa. authorized is true. No login, cookies, or stored page content. Price 0.05 USD in USDC on Base, settled after a successful scan. Automated checks find roughl

tools.name: scan_site
tools.description: WCAG 2.2 accessibility audit of up to 10 same-origin pages, starting from start_url. Returns rule ids, impact, and the top issues. authorized is true. Price 0.50 USD in USDC on Base, settled after a successful scan. Automated checks find roughly 57% of WCAG issues.

tools.name: report
tools.description: WCAG accessibility report in Markdown (de, fr, or en) from a same-origin scan of up to 10 pages, with a prioritised fix list. Not legal advice and no compliance guarantee. No model calls. Price 1.00 USD in USDC on Base, settled after a successful scan.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "scan_page" references sensitive artifacts (cookie). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
